turns.ask: 我们在东南亚运营一家网上商店，每天大约 3 万用户，大促期间流量激增。请设计一个高可用的 Web 架构。

ops.text: 我将为您设计一个高可用的东南亚电商架构，使用新加坡区域双可用区部署，ESA加速并应对大促流量激增。

ops.label: 购物用户
ops.why: 每天约3万用户访问网上商店浏览和下单。

ops.label: 云解析DNS
ops.why: 将商店域名解析到ESA边缘节点。

ops.label: ESA 边缘安全加速
ops.why: 为东南亚用户提供静态缓存、动态加速及内置DDoS防护。

ops.label: 应用负载均衡ALB
ops.why: 跨双可用区分发HTTP流量，支撑大促高并发。

ops.label: Web应用防火墙WAF
ops.why: 防御OWASP攻击、CC刷单和恶意爬虫。

ops.label: Web应用服务器
ops.why: 运行电商核心业务逻辑，双可用区高可用部署。

ops.label: 弹性伸缩ESS
ops.why: 大促期间根据CPU指标自动扩容ECS实例应对流量激增。

ops.text: 接下来配置会话缓存、数据库和对象存储，确保数据层高可用。

ops.label: Tair 会话与商品缓存
ops.why: 缓存购物车、用户会话和热点商品数据，降低数据库压力。

ops.label: RDS MySQL 订单库
ops.why: 持久化订单和用户数据，主备双可用区保障高可用。

ops.label: OSS 商品图片存储
ops.why: 存储商品图片和静态资源，由ESA边缘直接分发。

ops.text: 最后添加日志服务用于监控和排障。

ops.label: SLS 日志服务
ops.why: 集中收集应用和网关日志，支持大促实时监控告警。

ops.summary: 东南亚高可用电商架构：ESA边缘加速、ALB+WAF双可用区接入、ECS弹性伸缩、Tair缓存与RDS主备数据库。

ops.why: Routes storefront traffic and order API requests across two zones.

ops.label: WAF
ops.why: Blocks injection attacks and bots before reaching the app.

ops.label: Order API servers

ops.text: Sessions go to Tair, orders to RDS, and images to OSS, all within Malaysia.

Chose Serverless App Engine (SAE) for eight microservices (ride, driver, rider, dispatch, fare, payment, notification, rating) to enable serverless scaling without cluster management. Integrated Cloud-native API Gateway with WAF for security, PolarDB for relational data, and Tair for caching, all deployed across multi-zone configurations for high availability. Supporting services include OSS for media, SLS for logs, ESA/DNS for edge routing, and standard VPC networking. No open questions remain regarding the core architecture constraints.

ops.label: Product images
ops.why: Stores uploaded product images served by ESA.

ops.label: Order events
ops.why: Decouples order placement from email notifications.

ops.label: Email worker
ops.why: Consumes order events and sends notification emails.

ops.label: Direct Mail
ops.why: Delivers transactional order and account emails.

ops.label: NAT Gateway
ops.why: Outbound access for payment gateway calls.

ops.text: Adding observability for monitoring and logging.

ops.label: Logs
ops.why: Centralizes application and access logs.

ops.label: Prometheus
ops.why: Monitors ECS, RDS and Tair health metrics.

ops.text: I'll design a Kubernetes-free B2B invoicing backend using SAE for the REST API and workers, with RDS PostgreSQL.
Avoid Kubernetes completely

ops.label: Cloud DNS
ops.why: Resolves the API domain to ESA.

ops.label: ESA
ops.why: Accelerates and secures API traffic at the edge.

ops.label: ALB
ops.why: Distributes inbound API traffic across zones.

ops.label: WAF
ops.why: Blocks injection and bot attacks on the API.

ops.label: API Gateway
ops.why: Routes REST endpoints with auth and throttling.

ops.label: Invoicing API
ops.why: Serverless containers hosting the REST API.

ops.label: Session cache
ops.why: Caches auth tokens and frequent lookups.

ops.label: PostgreSQL
ops.why: Primary store for invoices, customers and payments.

ops.text: Background workers consume invoice jobs from RocketMQ and generate PDFs stored in OSS.

ops.label: RocketMQ
ops.why: Decouples API requests from async invoice processing.

ops.label: Invoice workers
ops.why: Background containers processing invoicing tasks.

ops.label: Invoice PDFs
ops.why: Stores generated invoice documents securely.

ops.label: NAT Gateway
ops.why: Gives workers outbound internet without public IPs.

ops.label: Logs
ops.why: Centralized logging for API and workers.
